These stores purchase overstock inventory, Amazon returns, and liquidated items from major retailers like Target, Walmart, and Home Depot, then pass massive discounts to shoppers. From electronics and home goods to clothing, toys, furniture, and household essentials, Virginia's 34 bin stores offer treasure-hunt shopping experiences where you can save 50-90% off retail prices. Most stores follow a weekly pricing model, restock on specific days (usually Friday or Saturday), and maintain active Facebook pages with updates.
